subject: Dataset & Prompt Pack Exchange — MAP + Close Timeline
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 4 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP draft + prompt pack exchange — proposed cadence

Hi Alicia,

Thanks again for the meeting earlier — nice alignment on scope. I attached a short MAP that captures the exchange cadence and acceptance gates we discussed. High level proposal:

- Redwood provides: BrightCart ephemeral prompt pack (prompt-pack-v2) + 5 curated test cases.
- BrightCart provides: 2 representative evaluation datasets (anonymized CSVs) and a small set of user-conversation test cases.
- Usage constraints: evaluation-only license, no redistribution, no training on unaggregated samples, access expires 30 days after delivery (sandbox takedown).

Acceptance gates and timeline (proposed):
1) 03/08 — Redwood delivers sandbox + prompt pack + ingestion notes.
2) 03/10 — BrightCart ingests and runs first pass; provides feedback + any redlines to the MAP.
3) 03/15 — Joint acceptance run (predefined 50 test cases); pass/fail criteria in MAP section 3.
4) 03/18 — Final sign-off and return/destruction plan initiated.

Attachments in this email: MAP_BrightCart_20270304.pdf (MAP draft), BrightCart_promptpack_v2.zip (prompt templates & rubric).

Key asks for you: 1) Confirm BrightCart is comfortable with the 30-day sandbox window and the evaluation-only license; 2) Send the anonymized dataset files and any ingestion quirks by 03/08; 3) If you need a different acceptance criteria set, please redline the MAP doc and indicate in your reply.

If ok, I’ll loop Karthik for sandbox provisioning and Naomi for guardrail checks.

Thanks — 
Sergio

Hi Sergio — thanks for the MAP. Quick notes from our side after a quick scan:

1) 30-day sandbox window is generally fine, but we need an option to request a one-time 14-day extension in case ingestion delays pop up (we commit to flagging extension requests at least 3 days before takedown).
2) Usage constraint: we need stronger language around non-derivation for model training (no checkpointing, no fine-tuning) — we’ll propose a short clause in a redline.
3) Can you confirm logging/audit availability for the sandbox (who accessed which dataset and when)? We’ll need at least 90 days of access logs for our compliance team.

Attaching our security questionnaire answers (BrightCart_SecQ-answers.pdf) and a small sample of the anonymized CSV schema. We intend to deliver the full datasets by EOD 03/08 — there will be 2 files (~120MB total).

We’ll review your prompt pack once the sandbox is live; if Karthik can provide an ETA for provisioning that will help.

Thanks —
Alicia

- Naomi: please review the MAP clause on non-derivation and our suggested language for evaluation-only licensing. Also confirm whether our current audit log retention meets BrightCart's ask; if not, propose an exception process.

- Marissa: coordinate with legal on the redline for the training prohibition and the extension clause. If legal wants wording tweaks, loop me — this is time-sensitive for the deal close.
